name: get-php-versions
description: Discover stable PHP releases matching Composer constraints

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && ncc build src/index.js --out dist --target es2022 --no-cache --minify --license licenses.txt
scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- dist)"
